### Choosing Honor When I Feel Dishonored - Encouragement for Today - January 21, 2021
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-january-21-2021.html
Passage: Hosea 10:12
Points:
- Believers are called to choose righteousness and honor God, even when facing mistreatment or personal hurt.
- Making choices aligned with God yields spiritual fruit rooted in His unfailing love.
- Pain and heartbreak can break up hardened hearts to prepare them for new spiritual growth.
- Seeking God requires creating space for His grace instead of reacting out of bitterness or emptiness.
- Honoring the Lord through difficult circumstances positions the believer to receive His refreshing showers of blessing.
